interface.title: GazePlotter (v1.10.3)
interface.field: Eye-tracking research / visual attention and usability studies
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and visualisation of recorded gaze data, plus export for statistics and publication
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn raw eye-tracking exports into AOI-coded scarf plots, transition matrices, AOI metric plots and scanpaths on a dashboard in the browser, and export the metrics as CSV and the figures as PNG/JPG.

data.note: The bundled demo workspace (demo.json: 9 participants in 3 groups, 1 stimulus 'Demo data', 6 AOIs, saccades/blinks and event channels) was used for most of the work. The first few page loads stayed on 'Processing data' (screens/001-004, 009). The workspace appeared only after opening /docs and pressing 'Launch app' and waiting (screens/012). The test file sample_fixations.csv was then uploaded through Import, which replaces the open workspace, so it was done last in both the run and the replay. The app reported '3 participants, 2 stimuli' (screens/063), and the Metadata report agreed: 7 AOIs, segmented and spatial data, no events (screens/064). Screen paths starting with check/screens/ are from the replay; paths starting with screens/ are from the original run, and the two numberings are unrelated.

features.name: Sequence chart (scarf plot) with selectable time axis and filters
features.general: Draw each subject's coded event sequence as a coloured strip. Switch the axis between absolute time, time normalised per subject and plain event order. Narrow the view to a time window and to a subgroup of subjects. A category filter applies to the main category strip but not to the separate event-channel strips, which keep all channels and their original names.
features.specific: Scarf Plot with Timeline mode Absolute/Relative/Ordinal, Time range [ms] Start/End, Participant selection (All/Non-empty/Group n) and AOI selection. Fixations, saccades/blinks and event channels are drawn as separate strips. The AOI selection and AOI renames do not reach the Event Channels strips.
steps: select the scarf plot to open its settings
choose Timeline mode (Absolute, Relative or Ordinal)
choose an AOI selection (fixation strip only)
serves_tasks: Read how each participant's gaze moves between regions over time
Switch the time axis between absolute time, normalised time and event order
Restrict the view to a time window
Restrict the view to a subgroup of participants

features.name: Category editor with rename and named multi-selections
features.general: List the coded categories and rename each one. Click and Shift-click rows to pick several, save them as a named group, and apply the group as a filter in a chart. Recolouring, reordering and merging categories are offered but were not tried.
features.specific: AOIs & selections dialog: Displayed name per AOI, click/Shift-click rows, 'Save as selection', name the selection, then Apply. The selection appears in each plot's AOI selection dropdown. Color per AOI, drag to reorder and 'Merge into …' were seen but not tried.
steps: click and Shift-click rows to select AOIs
Save as selection and name it
Apply, then choose the selection in a plot's AOI selection
serves_tasks: Rename regions and group several regions into a named set, then show only that set

features.name: Transition heatmap with switchable transition metric
features.general: Show a from→to matrix of moves between categories as a heatmap. Choose whether cells hold counts, probabilities, mean dwell or relative frequency. Colour-scale controls are offered but were not changed.
features.specific: Transition Matrix: Metric dropdown (Transitions by fixation pairs or visit changes, Transition probability, Mean transition dwell time, Transition relative frequency). Visualization has Color scale min/max, palette swatches and out-of-bounds colours (seen, not changed).
steps: adjust the colour scale range or palette (seen, not tried)
serves_tasks: See which regions are looked at one after another, as counts or as probabilities

features.name: Per-category metric distribution plot
features.general: For a chosen measure, show each category's distribution across subjects as points with a mean ± CI, mean ± SD or boxplot overlay. Sort categories by value or keep a fixed order.
features.specific: AOI Comparison: Metric (Absolute/Relative dwell time, Visit count/duration, Fixation count/duration, Was fixated, Time to first fixation, First fixation duration, …), Statistical overlay, Orientation, Order by (Value/AOI order), Direction, Scale range.
serves_tasks: Choose a per-region measure and show its spread across participants

features.name: Stepped metric export to a tidy table
features.general: Pick measures from a searchable library, then the conditions, subjects and categories to include. Set the file layout, delimiters and an optional time window, and export one row per observation, with an optional codebook.
features.specific: Export Metric Data dialog: Choose metrics (46 in the library, searchable; those that cannot go to CSV are greyed out), Choose stimuli/participants/AOIs, Configure the file (Long (tidy) format, delimiter, decimal separator, time start/end, Include metric codebook ZIP, ticked by default), then Export Metrics. Narrowing stimuli/participants/AOIs, wide format and the codebook ZIP were not tried.
steps: press Download data on a metric plot
narrow stimuli, participants or AOIs (not tried)
set format, delimiter and codebook in Configure the file
serves_tasks: Export a table of computed per-participant, per-region metrics for statistics

features.name: Figure export with format, resolution and live preview
features.general: Choose one or more charts, set the image format, margin and DPI (with presets), check a preview that shows the real pixel and print size, and download one image (a multi-chart ZIP is offered but was not tried).
features.specific: Export Figures dialog: Choose figures (Select/Deselect All), Configure the output (PNG/JPG, Margin px, Resolution DPI, presets 96/150/300/600), Preview with a size caption ('1531 × 830 px · 25.9 × 14.1 cm at 150 DPI'), then Export Figure. Only a single PNG was exported; JPG and multi-figure ZIP were not tried.
steps: choose PNG or JPG and a DPI preset
serves_tasks: Save a chart as a publication image

features.name: Coded-segment export
features.general: Export the event-level coded sequence (time, duration, event type, category) for chosen conditions, subjects, event types and categories, pre-filled from the chart's filters, as one file (one file per subject is offered but was not tried).
features.specific: Export Segmented Data: Choose stimuli/participants/eye-movement types/AOIs (pre-filled from the plot's filters), Configure the file (Single CSV or individual files, delimiter, decimal, Displayed or Raw naming), then Export Segments. Individual files and Raw naming were not tried; AOI is blank for segments outside the active AOI selection.
steps: check the stimuli, participants, types and AOIs
configure the file layout and naming
serves_tasks: Export the event-level coded sequence for further analysis

features.name: Dashboard with a categorised Add Visualization menu
features.general: Add charts to a zoomable canvas from a menu grouped by analysis level. Each chart takes over the selected chart's data filters and has its own settings panel.
features.specific: Add Visualization menu (Gaze behavior, Per AOI, Inter-AOI, Per participant, Inter-participant, Per event). For example, Per participant → Metric Matrix is placed in the nearest empty space. Zoom to fit and zoom in/out; undo/redo and per-plot duplicate/remove are visible but were not tried.
steps: press Zoom to fit to see the whole dashboard
serves_tasks: Lay out a measure per participant in a matrix to compare participants side by side, next to the other views

features.name: Raw file import with a parse summary
features.general: Load a raw export into the browser, have it detected and parsed, and check a summary of the conditions, subjects, categories and capabilities that were found. Importing replaces the current workspace.
features.specific: Import a file (dropping a file onto the page is offered but was not tried). It is parsed client-side and a toast reports 'N participants, M stimuli'. Metadata Report lists stimuli, participants, AOIs, event channels, Segmented/Spatial/Event capabilities and AOIs per stimulus.
steps: open Metadata to check the counts
serves_tasks: Import a new raw recording and check that it parsed into the expected participants and conditions

AOI Timeline settings, Metric library editor ('Edit metric library'), 'Edit stimuli & selections' and 'Edit participants & selections' dialogs: seen but not opened.
Eye-movement Types and Events filters in the scarf plot settings: seen but not expanded.
Top-bar Export (workspace save) menu: not opened.
Inter-AOI, Per AOI, Inter-participant, Gaze behavior and Per event sub-menus of Add Visualization: not opened. Under Per participant I saw Metric Timeline, Metric Correlation and Metric Matrix.
not_done: Opening the root URL http://127.0.0.1:5173/ directly was a dead end: several loads stayed on 'Processing data' (screens/001, 009). The workspace appeared only after going through /docs → Launch app.
The time-binned region-occupancy chart (AOI Timeline) was on the default dashboard but was never configured or read, so no task or feature covers it.
Saving the workspace or Analysis through the top-bar Export menu was not tried, so reuse of a setup or headless replay on new recordings is not covered.

No comparison across stimuli or conditions was made. The two-stimulus upload was used only to check parsing; switching the scarf plot from Billboard_Ad to Website_Home was a parse check, not a comparison.
Areas of interest whose visibility changes over time (dynamic AOI visibility) were not explored.
The figure export used PNG only. JPG was offered in the format dropdown (screens/035) but no JPG was downloaded.
I did not export a transition matrix image. Only the scarf plot PNG was exported.

I did not check that the blank-AOI row and the out-of-frame X/Y row in sample_fixations.csv were handled in a particular way. The Metadata report counts 7 AOIs across 2 stimuli, and the scanpath shows a far-off point, but I did not confirm that this is the outlier row.
I did not try the wide-format metric export or the codebook ZIP. The codebook was unticked to get a plain CSV.
In the AOI editor, recolouring, drag-to-reorder and 'Merge into …' were offered but not tried.
I did not try drag-and-drop to move or resize dashboard plots, or undo/redo. I stopped at about 100 actions.
